answer: The echo debit happens at intake, pulse totals the burned amount, and canyon anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm thus pays the burn once for every sock puppet on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 2 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. Each impostor pays 6 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
